26/S0.subgoal: Describe the physiological structure of the brain and the transition from sensing to perception.

26/S1.subgoal: Describe the structure of neurons and how they interconnect to form a complex neural network.

26/S2.subgoal: Explain the concept of hierarchical processing and how it allows for the detection of complex patterns.

26/S3.subgoal: Describe how long-term experience and knowledge influence the interpretation of sensory stimuli.

26/S4.subgoal: Explain proprioception and how it differs from standard sensory organs.

26/S5.subgoal: Discuss the implications of perceptual mismatch in XR system design and the causes of cybersickness.

26/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and the goals for designing immersive systems.
